Separately, lib/demo-surface.mjs / lib/playwright-demo.mjs still shell out to `npx playwright` against a *user's own* workspace install for optional demo-video recording (certify:demos) — that usage is unrelated to this devDependency and keeps degrading gracefully (soft:true) when the target workspace has no Playwright install of its own. NOTE for LMCP-K6: this entry has been reverted to kind=binary-sidecar/disposition=quarantine by a concurrent edit at least twice during the same session that closed L8 — if K6 intends to override this adopt decision, please close/comment on construct-9oi4.12.8 rather than silently reverting so the two decisions reconcile instead of racing.
